_meta.description: Seed list used by Veritrace's source-credibility module. It is an editorial heuristic, NOT an authoritative rating of any publisher. Tiers: 'established' = long-running news agencies, public broadcasters, scientific journals and public-health/government science bodies with published corrections policies; 'satire' = openly satirical outlets; 'flagged' = domains that independent fact-checking organisations have repeatedly documented as publishing fabricated or demonstrably false stories. Any domain not listed is scored from structural heuristics only. Edit freely: the file is read at startup.
